title: NamingTaxonomy
description: Pattern-first naming taxonomy for paths, crates, CI jobs, merge contexts, checks, and policy faces. Extends capability-first (ADR-0701/0562), plane hubs (ADR-0119), and service colocation (ADR-0131 lineage). Brand-first prefixes are debt, not grammar.

extends: ADR-0562 (C/P/A/F faces — topology retained under ADR-0701)
docs/standards/crate-naming-convention.md (role segments; brand-prefix clause SUPERSEDED for greenfield)
supersedes_for_greenfield: ADR-0017 / crate-naming-convention required_prefix=oya- as durable greenfield law
brand-first cloud-ci-* / oya-cloud-ci-* gate and binary names
_meta.acceptance_note: Promoted Accepted on #1644 so Claim rename/classifier refusal criteria match ADR-0711 Amendment B/C + END-STATE-POLICY (Proposed carries no implement authority).

pattern_first_law.rule: Grammar, semantics, taxonomy, structure, and architecture MUST follow an established pattern. If no hyperscaler-maintainable AND mechanically-classifiable pattern exists, ESTABLISH THE PATTERN FIRST (this file + ADR amendment), THEN apply renames/reorgs as instances. No one-off bespoke names.
pattern_first_law.greenfield_test: path + filename alone convey purpose without requiring brand lore or ADR number recall

capability-root.description: Registered capability top-level directory with C/P/A/F faces

plane-hub.name_shape: topic tokens; no product brand prefix

meta-root.description: Platform meta rung outside capability ladder
meta-root.integ: integ/<meta> when registered else destination integ

check-crate.description: Hermetic governance/fitness check engine under governance/check/

ci-facade.description: CI admission gate / producer under ci/facade/

ci-job.description: GitHub Actions (or successor) job display name and job key
ci-job.name_shape: role-first prose or kebab; NO ADR numbers; NO brand prefixes

merge-gate-context.description: Single required branch-protection / merge-admission status context
merge-gate-context.path_shape: workflow fan-in job name (and any dual-emit alias)
merge-gate-context.name_shape: <role>-required — describes admission role, not product brand
merge-gate-context.dual_emit_rule: While protection still keys the legacy context, emit BOTH legacy and forever names as sibling fan-in jobs with identical needs/verdict. Founder flips protection in one line; then delete legacy job.

service-colocation.description: Product/service artifacts colocated with owning capability or app/<product>

decision-record.description: Live architecture decision file under docs/decisions/
decision-record.name_shape: ADR-NNNN-<topic> kebab; number is durable path segment; indexes/frontmatter carry nav
decision-record.integ: integ/docs (hub) with integ/specs adjunct when co-landing doctrine
decision-record.batch_rule: MUST NOT mass-rename ADR files for taxonomy optics; keep ADR-NNNN-<topic>; indexes carry nav (adr-rename-overturn)
decision-record.achieves: Stable citation paths + ordered indexes without high-fan-in rename churn
decision-record.origin: Challenged Pattern-First draft that treated ADR-NNNN path prefixes as indefensible
decision-record.ensure: overturned_patterns OP-adr-numbered-decision-paths verdict=keep; ADR-0711 Amendment E
decision-record.overturn_when: Measured findability failure + batched judged rename plan clears 16-lens with dual-emit cutover

process-kit.description: Owned Rust process tooling surfaces (thin; not product)
process-kit.name_shape: tool role; no product brand in durable authority paths
process-kit.integ: integ/specs bootstrap adjunct or process-kit integ

shared-lib-debt.description: libs/ shared crates pending base/ or capability-core reorg (Amendment B reorg_now)
shared-lib-debt.integ: integ/libs during strangler; destination integ/<capability> or integ for base/

grammar.self_explanatory_path_test: A new engineer reading only the path+filename can state the unit's job without opening an ADR or brand glossary
grammar.forbidden_leading_brand_note: Leading product-brand prefixes are anti-patterns for durable names. Historical citations and carve-outs in deny-lists are not greenfield grammar. Brand prefix alone NEVER justifies keep_forever.

forbidden_path_segments.where: path segments and durable filenames OUTSIDE docs/decisions/
allowed_in: docs/decisions/ADR-NNNN-<topic>.md (Amendment E / adr-rename-overturn — forever path shape)
forbidden_path_segments.note: CI job titles and non-decision durable paths still MUST NOT embed ADR-NNNN; decision-record filenames KEEP ADR-NNNN-<topic>

forbidden_user_visible_tokens: ADR-[0-9]{4} inside CI job name: fields
firewall as brand for baseline-ratchet role
retired CI/SCM brand stems as live product vocabulary
grammar.ci_job_name_grammar: <role> [(short qualifier)] — no ADR numbers, no brand prefixes, no opaque metaphors

classification_rules.when: path matches registered capability root from governance/capability-registry.json
path under docs/|specs/|templates/|contracts/|registry/|evidence/ AND cross-cutting (not product dump)
classification_rules.integ: integ/docs or integ/specs per hubs sole-owner

classification_rules.when: path under governance/check/<name>/ OR libs/oya-check-* OR libs/oya-governance-*
classification_rules.debt_signal: libs/oya-check-* and libs/oya-governance-* are branded shared-lib-debt pending move/rename into governance/check/<role>

classification_rules.when: path under ci/facade/<name>/ OR historical cloud/cloud-ci/gates/* OR buck/cargo name oya-cloud-ci-*
GitHub workflow job key or job name: field under .github/workflows/
fan-in job that is the sole required branch-protection context OR alias thereof
oya-ci.toml [[gates.enabled]].id OR gate-disposition / baseline / policy JSON faces
libs/** with leading oya-/cloud- OR Amendment B libs/ reorg_now

canonical_instances.what_it_does: Fan-in job: green IFF every required gate lane succeeded; sole branch-protection merge context today
Fast lane: stale Cargo.lock + stale generated faces first diagnosis
Merge-base baseline compare-mode + ratchet-invariant; blocks NEW debt; hosts gate-registration meta-test
Binding affected-set cone or fail-closed full workspace run
Cold CAS/cache integrity canary outside merge fan-in

canonical_instances.land_plan: rename workflow file after dual-emit+protection flip; update all path pins in same land
canonical_instances.what_it_does: Workflow file hosting the required merge-admission fan-in
Enabled-gate accounting ids consumed by baseline producer / disposition table
Buck/cargo binaries for CI facades; role already often in directory name

canonical_instances.name_forever: <domain>-<role> under base/ or owning capability core/ (strip leading oya-)
canonical_instances.what_it_does: Shared kernels/adapters/checks still branded; Amendment B libs/ is reorg_now
Live ADR path shape; number is citation-stable durable segment
challenges: chestertons_fence: numbered ADR catalogs exist for chronology+citation — fence holds
blast_radius_cell: mass-rename is high fan-in with no measured findability win
essentialism_yagni: indexes already provide topic nav; path churn is not irreducible

canonical_instances.what_it_does: Fixture corpus for admission baseline-ratchet predicates

inventory_cohorts.description: Mechanically classifiable cohorts for naming_sweep. Exact path lists are regenerated by inventory scripts; cohorts bind kind+grammar so Claim/CI can classify without bespoke names.

cohorts.match: .github/workflows/** job name: fields matching forbidden grammar
fan-in required context names with leading brand
libs/oya-* directories and Cargo package names
libs/oya-check-* | libs/oya-governance-* | governance/check/* (check dirs often already role-first)

order: land this taxonomy + ADR Pattern-First on integ/specs
record naming_sweep rows citing kind + grammar_compliant
execute taxonomy instances on owning integ (high-confidence in-repo first)
no mass rename without judgment_status=done and taxonomy kind

lens_battery.rule: Judgments that keep or replace existing patterns MUST set lenses_applied=all-16 and challenges[]. Taxonomy REPLACES indefensible practice; it must not encode anti-patterns as forever grammar.

overturned_patterns.chestertons_fence: Single required merge context (ADR-0515/0700) plus product-brand cohesion for the fan-in job name and branch-protection string.
challenges: cartesian_doubt: code shows the job is a needs-fan-in verdict aggregator — brand token adds zero behavior
essentialism_yagni: single required context is the irreducible mechanism; brand prefix is not
chestertons_fence: fence was cohesion+protection pin — keep single context, replace name via dual-emit
contrarian: forever name should state admission role, not product brand
pragmatism: dual-emit lets protection flip be one founder line without merge outage
operability_day2: operators searching logs for brand miss the admission meaning
zero_trust: protection pin must stay explicit during rename — never silent retarget
overturned_patterns.indefensible: leading oya- brand as durable context identity

overturned_patterns.name_now: CI job name: fields embedding ADR-NNNN
overturned_patterns.chestertons_fence: Operators used ADR numbers in titles as a jump link to governing decisions during Phase-0 go-live.
challenges: cartesian_doubt: job title is not an index; ADR INDEX / comments already cite numbers
essentialism_yagni: title needs role + short qualifier only
socratic: why must a merge check name require ADR recall to understand?
operability_day2: opaque ADR soup slows incident triage for people outside the writing cohort
finops: cognitive load tax on every PR check list
overturned_patterns.indefensible: ADR number as user-visible name segment

overturned_patterns.name_now: leading oya-/cloud- on crates, gates, bins, faces
overturned_patterns.chestertons_fence: ADR-0017 / crate-naming-convention required oya- for workspace uniqueness mirroring aws-/google-cloud- prefix shapes.
challenges: contrarian: hyperscaler prefixes name the *vendor SDK surface*; inside an owned monorepo the capability/role IS the namespace
essentialism_yagni: directory + capability-registry already disambiguate
systems_thinking: brand prefix couples every rename to product marketing and freezes dual vocabulary (ci/facade/baseline-ratchet vs oya-cloud-ci-firewall-*)
red_team: brand residue gates already fight retired brand stems — encoding oya- as required greenfield law fights the de-brand north star
pragmatism: ci/facade/* dirs already moved to role-first; cargo/buck/bin names lag — taxonomy makes lag debt, not law
overturned_patterns.indefensible: required_prefix=oya- / cloud-ci-* as greenfield forever grammar

overturned_patterns.chestertons_fence: Phase-0 FIREWALL-PLAN used firewall as go-live metaphor for the single readiness ratchet over born-blocking gates.
challenges: cartesian_doubt: lib docs describe compare-mode + ratchet-invariant — not a network firewall
socratic: what does firewall do that baseline-ratchet does not already name?
operability_day2: on-call chasing firewall finds metaphor, not the merge-base baseline face
telemetry_first: job/echo labels saying cloud-ci-firewall diverge from path ci/facade/baseline-ratchet
overturned_patterns.defensible_core: baseline ratchet + gate-registration meta-test as admission predicates

overturned_patterns.chestertons_fence: Numbered ADR catalogs are industry-common for chronology and citation.
challenges: chestertons_fence: numbered paths are industry-common citation anchors — state why before removing
blast_radius_cell: mass-rename of 400+ ADRs is high fan-in with dual-truth risk during cutover
pragmatism: indexes/frontmatter already solve topic findability without path churn
opportunity_cost: rename theater displaces land of binding law (#1644)
cartesian_doubt: no measured evidence that topic-only paths improve operator outcomes here
overturned_patterns.defensible_core: stable ADR-NNNN-<topic> citation paths + ordered indexes/frontmatter for nav
